title: Alashiya
text:
A name that appears in the letters of kings: a source of copper, a kingdom worth writing to. Whether Alashiya is Cyprus, part of Cyprus, or somewhere else has been argued for a century.

The people of the island do not call it Alashiya. That is what other people's scribes call it.

sources: Amarna letters referring to Alashiya, general
provenance.notes: The name and its copper are attested; the identification with Cyprus is the standard reading, not a certainty.
